acceptance.text: Functional test results cover positive, negative, validation and restricted-access behaviours; repairs have retest proof.
Non-functional testing supplies measured performance, reliability, security, accessibility and usability evidence against approved criteria and records limitations.
System/E2E tests demonstrate complete journeys through frontend, API, database and deployed environment, including persistence and errors.
All five Gamers complete independent 2.5-hour Client’s Chair UAT cards with evidence-backed Pass/Fail/Blocked findings.
All confirmed defects have assigned dispositions and retests where fixed; no acceptance-blocking defect remains; CC explicitly approves any minor deferral.
All 21 acceptance checks previously approved across Sprints 1–3 continue to pass regression.
Final tested release is deployed, smoke-tested and formally accepted by CC after resolving or approving UAT findings; Key 4 decision recorded.

evidence: Frozen cards and gates matched the handover checksum register.
CC draft, approval and load passed. Unapproved load and Gamer draft rejected.
All 20 saved cards match frozen IDs, hours, definitions, owners and dependencies.
Assigned Gamers can start UAT-01 to UAT-04. Another Gamer cannot start UAT-01.
Before prerequisite completion, UAT-05 was blocked and CC acceptance was rejected without all seven gates.
The Sprint 3 record was byte-identical after the run.
